This validates the core progressive tax calculation engine against real Australian tax rules.

what_it_does: Tests business rule validation that prevents negative taxable income from being processed

signature: [TestCase] public async Task CalculateTaxAsync_2024_25_VariousIncomes_ReturnsExpectedTax(decimal income, decimal expectedTax)
what_it_does: Tests progressive tax bracket calculations across multiple income levels for 2024-25 financial year
how_it_works: Uses parameterized test cases to verify tax calculations at bracket boundaries: $18,200 (tax-free threshold = $0 tax), $45,000 (end of 16% bracket = $4,288), $85,000 (30% bracket = $19,238), $135,000 (end of 30% bracket = $31,288), $190,000 (end of 37% bracket = $51,638). Each test verifies the progressive tax formula where higher income portions are taxed at higher rates, ensuring the tax brackets are correctly implemented.

what_it_does: Tests the medicare levy calculation which is a mandatory 2% levy on taxable income

Verifies that medicare levy equals $2,000 (2% of $100,000) and that total levies equals the medicare levy amount. This validates the medicare levy business rule implementation.

what_it_does: Tests the Low Income Tax Offset (LITO) calculation which reduces tax liability for low-income earners
how_it_works: Calculates tax for $30,000 income with LITO enabled. Sets up LITO with maximum offset of $700, phase-out starting at $37,500 with 5% phase-out rate. Since $30,000 is below the phase-out threshold, verifies that the full $700 offset is applied. This validates the LITO business rule which provides tax relief to low-income Australian taxpayers.

what_it_does: Core tax calculation engine that processes a tax calculation request and returns comprehensive tax results
how_it_works: Validates input (non-negative income), retrieves appropriate tax brackets for the financial year (defaulting to 2024-25), calculates progressive income tax using bracket calculations, applies medicare levy (2% if enabled), calculates budget repair levy for 2015-18 years on income >$180k, applies LITO tax offset if enabled, computes net tax payable (ensuring non-negative), calculates effective and marginal tax rates. Returns complete TaxCalculationResult with all components including breakdown description.

signature: private decimal CalculateProgressiveIncomeTax(decimal income, List<TaxBracket> brackets)
what_it_does: Implements the Australian progressive income tax calculation using tax brackets
how_it_works: Iterates through tax brackets in order by BracketOrder. For each bracket, determines if income falls within the bracket range (MinIncome to MaxIncome or decimal.MaxValue for highest bracket). Calculates taxable amount in bracket as minimum of income vs bracket maximum, minus bracket minimum plus 1. Applies bracket formula: FixedAmount + (taxableInBracket × TaxRate). For progressive calculation, takes the applicable bracket tax amount and breaks when income is within bracket range.

signature: private decimal CalculateBudgetRepairLevy(decimal income, string financialYear)
what_it_does: Calculates the temporary Budget Repair Levy that applied to high income earners from 2015-16 to 2017-18
how_it_works: Checks if the financial year is one of 2015-16, 2016-17, or 2017-18. If yes and income exceeds $180,000, applies a 2% levy on the total income (income × 0.02). Returns 0 for all other years or income below threshold. This implements the temporary levy introduced by the Australian government to help repair the budget deficit.

what_it_does: Calculates the Low Income Tax Offset (LITO) which provides tax relief for low and middle income earners
how_it_works: Implements a simplified LITO calculation: full $700 offset for income ≤ $37,500, tapered reduction of $700 - ((income - $37,500) × 5%) for income between $37,500-$45,000, and $0 for income > $45,000. This offset reduces the actual tax payable and helps ensure lower income earners pay less tax.

signature: private decimal GetMarginalTaxRate(decimal income, List<TaxBracket> brackets)
what_it_does: Determines the marginal tax rate (tax rate on the next dollar earned) for a given income level
how_it_works: Searches through tax brackets to find the bracket where income falls within the range (income ≥ MinIncome and income ≤ MaxIncome or MaxIncome is null for highest bracket). Returns the TaxRate of the applicable bracket ordered by BracketOrder. The marginal rate represents the tax percentage applied to additional income earned at that income level.

what_it_does: Initializes the hard-coded tax bracket data for multiple Australian financial years
how_it_works: Creates a dictionary mapping financial years to their respective tax bracket structures. Includes 2024-25 (current): 0%, 16%, 30%, 37%, 45% brackets; 2023-24: 0%, 19%, 32.5%, 37%, 45%; and 2015-16: 0%, 19%, 32.5%, 37%, 45% with different thresholds. Each bracket specifies MinIncome, MaxIncome (null for highest), TaxRate, FixedAmount (cumulative tax from lower brackets), and BracketOrder. This data represents the official Australian Tax Office tax scales for each year.

signature: private TaxCalculationResult CalculateTax(decimal income, string year)
what_it_does: Standalone API version of the tax calculation engine for processing HTTP requests
how_it_works: Gets tax brackets for the specified year (defaults to 2024-25). Iterates through brackets to calculate progressive income tax: for each bracket, if income exceeds MinIncome, calculates tax for the bracket portion. If income exceeds bracket MaxIncome, applies full bracket tax and continues; otherwise calculates partial bracket tax and stops. Adds medicare levy (2% of income), budget repair levy (2% for 2015-18 years on income >$180k), and LITO offset. Computes gross tax, applies offsets, and returns TaxCalculationResult with all components including effective and marginal rates.

signature: private decimal GetMarginalRate(decimal income, List<TaxBracket> brackets)
what_it_does: Determines the marginal tax rate for a given income level in the standalone API context
how_it_works: Iterates through tax brackets to find the bracket where the income falls within the range (income ≥ MinIncome and either MaxIncome is null or income ≤ MaxIncome). Returns the TaxRate of the first matching bracket. This provides the tax rate that would apply to the next dollar of income earned at the specified income level.
